# Arm & Arm

> > Veteran-founded nonprofit providing addiction recovery, behavioral health, and reentry services in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

Founded by U.S. Army veteran Kelvin Manurs, Arm & Arm offers peer support and community-based programs serving individuals in Washington, DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia. The organization combines behavioral health services with community engagement through events like the annual Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Peace Walk & Parade.
